content: I purchased this foam mattress three months ago and it's been a complete disappointment. The first night, I noticed an overwhelming chemical smell that still hasn't fully disappeared despite airing it out for weeks. The mattress is far too soft and provides zero support - I wake up with terrible back pain every single morning. There's already a permanent body-shaped indent where I sleep, even though I've rotated it multiple times as recommended. The edges compress completely when you sit on them, making it impossible to use the full surface of the bed. It sleeps incredibly hot, leaving me sweating and tossing all night despite using cooling sheets. The company's "100-night trial" is a joke because they charge a hefty restocking fee and make you pay for return shipping. Save your money and buy a traditional spring mattress instead - this foam nightmare isn't worth the hype or the price.
